model: strict-prior v61-family LightGBM, outer split seed 2026, 40 folds
hypothesis: changing only the outer split seed from 104395303 to 2026 preserves strict OOF strength and yields a test estimate highly rank-correlated with both already qualified split seeds
formal_trigger: v80 must be COMPLETE and fully verified; v81 must be COMPLETE, fully verified, and pass its split_seed_robustness_gate before v82 training

strict_prior_contract.inner_hold: prior and category statistics use only that inner-train partition
strict_prior_contract.outer_valid: prior and category statistics use the complete outer-fit partition
strict_prior_contract.test: prior and category statistics use the complete outer-fit partition

comparison_boundary: v80, v81, and v82 use different outer partitions; compare complete OOF AUC and whole-vector Spearman only, never claim fold-paired improvement

strict_family_candidate_gate.meaning: minimum absolute strength for a strict family replication
